an7.83:1.1: athakho āyasmā upāli yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā upāli bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.83:2.1: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
an7.83:2.2: ye kho tvaṃ upāli dhamme jāneyyāsi
an7.83:2.3: ime dhammā na ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantīti
an7.83:2.5: neso dhammo neso vinayo netaṃ satthusāsananti
an7.83:2.6: ye ca kho tvaṃ upāli dhamme jāneyyāsi
an7.83:2.7: ime dhammā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantīti
an7.83:2.9: eso dhammo eso vinayo etaṃ satthusāsananti.
